numbersSubtitle: Manage WhatsApp Business Cloud API numbers and credentials.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this WhatsApp number? This action cannot be undone.

syncFromMetaUnavailable.__fn: missingEnvKeys=>`Sync from Meta is unavailable: missing WhatsApp configuration (${missingEnvKeys}). Set these values in the environment, or add a WhatsApp account below.`

syncSuccess: Successfully synced WhatsApp accounts from Meta.

syncSuccessWithCounts.__fn: (synced,added)=>{const syncedPhrase=synced===1?"1 number":`${synced} numbers`;if(added===0){return`Synced ${syncedPhrase} from Meta \u2014 all are already known here, nothing new was added.`}const addedPhrase=added===1?"1 new number was":`${added} new numbers were`;return`Synced ${syncedPhrase} from Meta \u2014 ${addedPhrase} added.`}

warningTierExceeded: Tier limit exceeded — messaging may be throttled

embeddedSignupDescription: Connect a number already used in the WhatsApp Business app. Your team keeps using the phone app while the platform can read and send messages.
embeddedSignupWaitingTitle: Complete the steps in the Meta window
embeddedSignupWaitingBody: Approve the connection in the Meta window (or in the WhatsApp Business app), then come back here. We'll finish setup automatically.
embeddedSignupCancelledBody: You left the Meta setup before finishing. Nothing was changed — you can start again whenever you're ready.
embeddedSignupSuccessBody: The number is connected. Contacts and chat history sync in the background — this can take up to 24 hours.
embeddedSignupNotConfigured: Embedded signup is not configured for this environment.
embeddedSignupStepCompleteInApp: Complete in the WhatsApp Business app
embeddedSignupVersionNote: Requires WhatsApp Business app 2.24.17 or newer on the staff phone.
embeddedSignupSyncInfo: Chat history and contacts sync in the background after connecting — this can take up to 24 hours. Your team keeps using the phone app in the meantime.
embeddedSignupErrorBody: The connection could not be completed. No number was connected — you can restart the onboarding flow.
embeddedSignupCompletingBody: Confirming the connection and queueing the contacts and history sync. This only takes a moment.
embeddedSignupAllowedOriginsTitle: First-time setup: allow this app in Meta

embeddedSignupAllowedOriginsBody.__fn: origin=>`Meta only returns the signup code to registered origins. Before launching, add ${origin} under App Dashboard \u2192 Facebook Login for Business \u2192 Settings \u2192 Allowed domains and Valid OAuth redirect URIs.`

embeddedSignupRequiresHttps: Connecting a number requires a secure HTTPS connection — Meta blocks the login flow on plain HTTP. Open this page over HTTPS to continue.
permissionDeniedDescription: You don't have permission to access this section. Contact an administrator if you believe this is an error.
purposeHelper: Chooses which notifications this number sends. Unassigned events fall back to the General number.
coexistenceRestrictionsHint: Coexistence numbers have some limits — broadcast lists and some app-only features stay in the WhatsApp Business app.
syncDeclinedGuidance: Inbox stays unavailable for this number until onboarding is re-run.
addNumberInfoBanner: Each number shares your portfolio messaging limit; quality is measured per number.
optInDefaultOffBanner: WhatsApp notifications are off by default; users opt in explicitly.
